intent: Three photorealistic transparent table looks for the hero; generated illustrations, not photographs of actual Legado events.
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: premium Chilean catering website hero, photographic table scene isolated with true transparent background. Create a highly realistic editorial food photograph, not CGI or illustration: a complete real round dining table for two viewed from elevated three-quarter angle, whole tabletop AND hanging cloth visible with generous transparent margin all around, no chairs or room. Ivory linen tablecloth drapes naturally with intricate real woven fibers and soft folds, aged brushed silver forks and knives, two handmade off-white ceramic place settings. Center: a beautiful generous bowl of Chilean ceviche with white fish, purple onion, cilantro and citrus. Two elegant stemmed glasses with pale white wine and a carafe of citrus water, two folded sage green linen napkins, tiny low vase of fresh greenery. Cohesive tasteful event styling, photographic imperfect details and physically accurate materials, realistic contact shadows. Camera 50mm lens, table occupies 80% of square image, camera at 50 degree elevation, table centered, warm soft directional studio light upper left, dark luxury mood yet clearly visible fabric. No text, no graphic elements, no line drawing, no floating individual items, no cropped table, no background, true alpha transparency. It must convincingly look like a photograph of a real fully laid banquet table.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the reference photographic table into a second complete dinner styling. Preserve EXACT camera angle, table silhouette, size, placement, lighting direction, transparency, two-person layout and photographic realism. Change ivory cloth to deep navy blue real satin with natural folds; sage napkins to champagne gold linen. Change all silver cutlery to brushed gold. Change ceramic plates to fine white porcelain with thin gold rims. Replace central ceviche with a beautiful platter of grilled beef medallions with roasted baby potatoes and rosemary, delicious realistic Chilean catering presentation. Replace both white wines with dark red wine in matching elegant stems; replace citrus water carafe with a small red wine decanter in same position. Replace greenery with a low arrangement of ivory flowers. Every item must sit physically on the table and cast coherent contact shadows. Complete table visible including hanging cloth, with transparent margins. No room/background, no text, no illustration, no plastic CGI appearance. Retain true alpha transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit reference photographic table to a third complete dessert/after-dinner styling. Preserve EXACT camera angle, table silhouette, size, placement, lighting direction, transparent background, two-person composition and high photographic realism. Change ivory cloth to dusty antique rose linen with natural draped folds; sage napkins to warm ivory folded napkins. All silver cutlery becomes polished copper dessert spoons and dessert forks, at each place. Change pottery to delicate ivory dessert plates. Replace central ceviche bowl with a low beautiful porcelain serving platter with two generous cocoa-dusted tiramisu portions, natural cream and sponge visible. Replace both white wine glasses with two slender champagne flutes filled with golden sparkling wine; replace water carafe with a small elegant glass champagne bottle without labels. Add two small espresso cups and saucers naturally near each dessert place setting. Replace greenery with a small low arrangement of blush and ivory flowers. No changes to position/scale of table, no cropping, no background/room, no text/labels, no stylization or CGI. Photoreal luxury catering editorial studio photograph, real woven textile detail and correct contact shadows. Preserve true alpha transparency.
